Massive domain authority and backlink profile
weaknesses: High lead volume may result in less personalized service

crossCompetitorInsights: Platform Dominance: 100% of top competitors analyzed use Real Estate Webmasters (REW), indicating that professional IDX performance and 'Community Silo' architecture are non-negotiable for Calgary SEO.

Content Shift: Competitors are moving away from general market updates toward high-intent 'Relocation Guides' (Toronto/Ontario to Calgary) and 'Cost of Living 2026' topics to capture out-of-province buyers.

Lead Magnet Evolution: Beyond standard 'Home Evaluations,' leaders like Justin Havre are offering 'Guaranteed Cash Offers' and 'Concierge' services to secure listings in a competitive inventory market.
Local Siloing: Every competitor uses a hierarchical URL structure for quadrants (NW, SW, etc.) and communities, which is missing or under-optimized on the client's current SIS platform.
recommendationsForClient: Leverage Banking Background: Neil should create an 'Investment ROI' blog series similar to jdrealestatecalgary.ca to utilize his 10-year banking experience—a unique USP none of the other agents fully exploit.

Implement Community Silos: Move beyond the limited Mirror/SIS structure to create dedicated, SEO-optimized landing pages for Calgary NW and specific target communities with custom copy and localized market stats.
Schema Markup Overhaul: Implement LocalBusiness, FAQ (for 'Selling your home'), and Person schema (to highlight 20+ years experience) to improve SERP real estate and CTR.

Aggressive Review Acquisition: Neil needs a systematic campaign to increase Google Reviews to compete with Havre (2600+) and Reeves (180+); even 50-75 reviews would place him ahead of Karen Fawcett digitally.
Relocation Content: Target the 'Ontario/BC to Calgary' migration trend with a 'Moving to Calgary Guide 2026' to capture top-of-funnel leads before they reach the MLS search stage.
